messages:
hana: Quick sync on the compact burst meter + SLO presets toggle in the autoscale panel. saw 2 accessibility and 1 UX annoyance in testing.
diego: hey! what annoyed folks?
pat: users missed the presets toggle because it's a subtle switch icon with no label in compact mode. they expected explicit text.
zoe: agreed. propose replacing icon-only toggle with visible text 'Presets' and a chevron for compact. keep icon as decoration only.
hana: also the burst meter uses small inline color only to indicate 'low/ok/high'. fails for colorblind users. need a pattern+text combo.
diego: pattern chips + text like 'Burst remaining: 2.1h (low)' or a small dot+label. but we should keep it compact: '2.1h • low'. screen readers need full phrase.
pat: for SR users, make the chip have aria-label='Burst remaining 2.1 hours, low' and hide the dot from assistive tech.
a11y-bot: Scan: detected insufficient contrast on amber token, recommend increasing to 4.5:1 for text overlay.
zoe: good call. let's use the alert color for warning text and bold the word 'low' instead of tiny color-only indicator.
hana: SLO presets: when toggling presets, UI animates the slider to new value but there's no live region update. Screen reader users can't tell what changed.
diego: add aria-live="polite" on the small status line that reads 'Applied preset: latency p99 250ms'. show that for 3s then hide.
pat: microcopy: preset dropdown label currently 'SLO' : change to 'SLO preset' and helper 'applies p99 latency target'. many missed the p99 detail.
zoe: keyboard: preset dropdown should be reachable in two tabs from the pool header in compact layout. currently it takes 4 because of hidden badges. make badges aria-hidden and announce via the header button's aria-describedby.
hana: visual nit: the compact meter collapses remaining-burst to stacked text at narrow widths, pushing the stepper off-screen. prefer truncation with ellipsis and tooltip for details.
diego: agree. tooltip should be reachable via keyboard (focusable) and have role="tooltip" + aria-describedby link.
pat: test plan: small Cypress test that tabs to presets, toggles, asserts that aria-live text updates and that badges are aria-hidden. also assert contrast of warning text >= 4.5.
a11y-bot: Reminder: schedule re-run of automated scan after changes merged.
zoe: updated figma: https://figma.com/file/uvwx9999/compact-burst-meter-presets — comments on badge hiding and tooltip.
hana: i'll draft a tiny copy + aria PR and ping for reviews. thanks!
